method.framePoses: Frozen affine frame normalization shared by every before/after; no text-derived or per-card rendering offsets.
method.objective: 55% symmetric edge agreement +45% filled-ink overlap, on inverted gray for white numerals. A fixed erased-native-background mask excludes the badge rim before evaluating candidates. Hollow ink cannot win by contributing extra edges.

fitTargets.weighting: Each distinct nonfoil planeswalker name weights one; four Teferi illustrations share one name. Within a name, ability labels share its weight.

method.search: Coordinate descent over shared x/y, size and horizontal glyph scale; compare original Beleren and Beleren2016, Canvas auto and fractional metrics.
method.selection: Starting loyalty uses the best shared fit. Ordinary ability labels retain the all-label fractional fit, which improves every ordinary label; its slightly higher-mean grouped alternative regresses one Teferi label and is rejected. Multi-digit labels have a separate width/position fit shared across both distinct names; it retains the badge ink limit.
method.validation: Reused development scans and five foil-only geometry controls, not a fresh independent set. The multi-digit cohort has only two distinct names; transfer beyond M21 remains subject to the modern-default audit.

review: All56 selected fields improve both filled/edge combined objective; all56 actual production crops match selected candidates within0.0002 grayscale units, with no pixel change outside their fixed windows. All14 native etching masks stay byte-identical.
The shared starting fit keeps the original Beleren font; ability costs use Beleren2016. Both explicitly request fractional metrics. Glyph scaling is bounded by the original badge maximum width.
No new image readback, decoding, font loading or compilation is introduced during animation. Adjustments apply during existing static face composition.
This resolves numeral typography only. Badge outlines/shadows, colons, remaining text/footer/basic-rim audits, final scan-pose certification, default transfer and release are separate.
